title: ProtoArena: Can AI Agents Discover and Exploit Real-World Cross-Component Protocol Vulnerabilities?
abstract: arXiv:2610.17837v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used for vulnerability analysis, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of exploitation that depends on interactions among network protocol components. Such vulnerabilities arise from inconsistencies in message interpretation, timing, state, or trust assumptions across participants. We introduce ProtoArena, a black-box, multi-component, dynamic benchmark with 80 cross-component vulnerability-exploitation environments spanning 11 protocol and application domains and 7 attack categories. Tasks are primarily informed by published protocol-attack mechanisms. Agents interact with running systems through scoped interfaces to achieve security-effect objectives without target source code. translated_title: ProtoArena：AI智能体能否发现并利用现实世界中跨组件的协议漏洞？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地被用于漏洞分析，然而现有基准测试对于依赖网络协议组件间交互的漏洞利用的覆盖十分有限。此类漏洞源于参与各方在消息解释、时序、状态或信任假设上的不一致性。我们推出了ProtoArena，这是一个黑盒、多组件、动态的基准测试，包含80个跨组件漏洞利用环境，涵盖11个协议与应用领域以及7个攻击类别。任务主要基于已发表的协议攻击机制构建。智能体通过范围受限的接口与运行中的系统交互，在无需目标源代码的情况下实现安全效果目标。基准设置了三个信息级别，分别评估有引导的漏洞复现、结合机制与拓扑上下文的漏洞利用，以及面向效果的黑盒探索。混合验证器将基于规则的检查与大语言模型评判相结合。
tldr: 提出ProtoArena——首个黑盒、多组件、动态基准测试，通过80个跨组件漏洞利用环境评估AI智能体发现和利用现实世界协议漏洞的能力。
en_tdlr: ProtoArena introduces a black-box, multi-component dynamic benchmark with 80 cross-component vulnerability-exploitation environments to evaluate whether AI agents can discover and exploit real-world protocol vulnerabilities.
